# SNN_STDP_Learning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-31

## Definition
A spiking neural network learning rule where synaptic weights are adjusted based on the precise timing of pre- and post-synaptic spikes. Enables online, local, and unsupervised learning in neuromorphic hardware, eliminating the need for global backpropagation.
